name: fact_checker
description: Check a specific factual claim containing numbers against source texts, allowing for different units (e.g. '$245.1 billion' vs '245,122 million') and a 5% tolerance. Use it on every material figure before it goes into the report. Returns supported / partially_supported / unsupported / unverifiable with a confidence score.

claim.description: The claim to verify, e.g. 'Microsoft revenue was $245.1 billion in FY2024'.

sources.description: Source texts to check against (e.g. excerpts of retrieved evidence).
